sources.title: Independent facility reference
sources.note: Official report confirms the historical marker returned in February 2025. Keep the existing sourced roof plan. The earlier facade tread intersected the standing church and is removed. A broad tread outside the actual northwest facade conflicts with the cached full-width Peñafrancia Avenue carriageway (way 1529540512); frontage alignment needs a current reference. Unsourced facade statue pedestals remain omitted. Marker and lamp placement remains schematic. No Google Maps imagery was inspected and no timeline dates are inferred.

sources.title: Draft surface placement audit
sources.note: Explicit paving overrides coarse ground fills only. Footprints are clipped to existing grounds and exclude mapped standing buildings and full-width carriageways. This geometry cleanup does not establish an otherwise unverified facility or current layout.
